svg.title: Incident report: force-push on a Friday
svg.desc: A pink winged dragon breathes fire at the pixel cat after a force-push. The cat flashes into an X-ray skeleton, turns to charcoal, crumbles into ash leaving its skeleton, then git revert brings it back with one of its nine lives used up.
